parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test targets: `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift` and `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift`. Both carry the name `MockArtworkService`, making them mock fixtures used within their respective test suites. Per the decision rules, any cluster where a participating record is a test fixture (is_test=true) mandates no-action. Consolidating these mocks into shared production or shared-test infrastructure would couple unrelated test packages and risk polluting production targets with mock semantics.
